Pass `false` if this a development render to not count it as a billable render on remotion.pro. Only can be used in conjuction with `licenseKey`.

## CLI flag

```text
--is-production
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)
- [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#isproduction)
- [`renderStillOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/renderstillonlambda#isproduction)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#isproduction)
- [`renderStill()`](/docs/renderer/render-still#isproduction)
- [`renderMediaOnWeb()`](/docs/web-renderer/render-media-on-web#isproduction)
- [`renderStillOnWeb()`](/docs/web-renderer/render-still-on-web#isproduction)
